Name: ATTACHEFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Relic and weapon effects. Each row applies SpEffects while the relic or weapon is equipped and sets the effect's text, value display and sort order, which heroes it applies to, and the exclusivity and compatibility IDs that stop the same kind of effect being applied twice or rolled twice on one item.

Fields.Name: On-Hit SpEffect ID 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by the holder's hits while this effect is active (first of three; -1: none). Added to the on-hit list with On-Hit SpEffect 2 and 3.

Fields.Name: On-Hit SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: Second on-hit SpEffect, added to the same list as On-Hit SpEffect ID. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: On-Hit SpEffect ID: 3
Fields.Description: Third on-hit SpEffect, added to the same list as On-Hit SpEffect ID. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the holder while this effect is active (first of three; -1: none). Relic and weapon effects collect all three.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied to the holder while this effect is active (-1: none).

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID: 3
Fields.Description: Third SpEffect applied to the holder while this effect is active (-1: none).

Fields.Name: Compatibility ID
Fields.Description: When a relic or weapon rolls its effects, a table entry whose Compatibility ID equals that of an effect already rolled on the same item is skipped, so effects sharing an ID never appear together. -1: no restriction.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text entry used for the effect's name and description in menus.

Fields.Name: Is Persistent Effect
Fields.Description: Stored with each passive SpEffect in the item's effect list. Clear: the status menu shows an extra active/inactive marker for the effect (its source must be in use). Retail: clear on 117 rows (weapon effects such as Magma upon Charge Attacks).

Fields.Name: Is Numeric Effect
Fields.Description: Set: menus show the effect's Displayed Value next to its name. Clear: no value is shown.

Fields.Name: Is Highest Potency
Fields.Description: Passed to the menu entry of the effect as a highlight flag. Retail: set on the highest potency of a weapon effect series (Potency 3, 84 rows).

Fields.Name: Is Debuff
Fields.Description: No reader found (its accessor has no callers). Retail: set on 78 rows, the penalty effects (Impaired Damage Negation talismans, weapon effects that hurt the holder).

Fields.Name: Lower Value Is Stronger
Fields.Description: When two effects with the same Override Base Effect ID are compared, the one with the lower Displayed Value counts as stronger (for reductions shown as negative values). 0: higher is stronger. Retail: set on Reduced Spell FP Cost, Less Likely to Be Targeted and Golden Retaliation (7 rows).

Fields.Name: Ignore Displayed Value
Fields.Description: If set, the Displayed Value is treated as 0 (shown value and strength comparison). Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Value Display Format
Fields.Description: How the Displayed Value is written: 0 = signed number, 1 = signed with the first unit text (%), 2 = unsigned with that text, 3 = signed with the second unit text, 4 = unsigned with it, 5 = plain unsigned number. Retail 0 or 1 (1 on 314 rows, talismans and weapon effects).

Fields.Name: Is for Wylder
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Wylder. Clear: it is skipped for him (relic effects of other heroes are not applied).

Fields.Name: Is for Guardian
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Guardian.

Fields.Name: Is for Ironeye
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Ironeye.

Fields.Name: Is for Duchess
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Duchess.

Fields.Name: Is for Raider
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Raider.

Fields.Name: Is for Revenant
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Revenant.

Fields.Name: Is for Recluse
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Recluse.

Fields.Name: Is for Executor
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Executor.

Fields.Name: Is for Scholar
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Scholar.

Fields.Name: Is for Undertaker
Fields.Description: Set: the effect works when the relic is used by Undertaker.

Fields.Name: Permanent SpEffect Count Type
Fields.Description: How the menu counts Permanent SpEffect ID: 0 = number of active instances of that SpEffect; 1 = highest level among active category 204 effects in the same hundred-block of IDs (the last two digits of the ID are the level).

Fields.Name: Status Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown for the effect in the status menus and relic lists.

Fields.Name: Effect Group ID
Fields.Description: Effects with the same value are levels of one effect: the status list shows them as one entry. -1: the effect is compared by its own row ID only.

Fields.Name: Displayed Value
Fields.Description: Number shown with the effect when Is Numeric Effect is set (0 when Ignore Displayed Value is set). Also decides which level of an Effect Group is the strongest (see Is Lower Value Stronger).

Fields.Name: Sort Order
Fields.Description: Sort key of the effect: the effects on a relic, and relics in the menus sorted by effect, are ordered by this value (lower first), ties by row ID.

Fields.Name: Filter Entry ID
Fields.Description: AttachEffectFilterParam row of the effect: the relic filter screen shows relics with an effect (or curse) whose entry matches the chosen filter. Retail: every value but one is an existing row.

Fields.Name: Non-Stacking Group ID
Fields.Description: Among the hero's equipped relics, only the first effect with a given value is applied; later effects with the same value are ignored. -1: always applied. Retail: 1000-1091 on the per-hero attribute relics, 100-900 on starting-armament, max HP/FP/stamina and similar groups.

Fields.Name: Permanent SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect whose active count (or level, see Permanent SpEffect Count Type) the status menu shows next to the effect, for effects that build up during the expedition (per great enemy defeated, per Sorcerer's Rise unlocked...). -1: none.
